crossRefs.note: John answered, “Master, we saw someone casting out demons in your name, and we forbade him, because he doesn’t follow…
For I most certainly, as being absent in body but present in spirit, have already, as though I were present, judged him…
This punishment which was inflicted by the many is sufficient for such a one;
We exhort you, brothers: Admonish the disorderly; encourage the faint-hearted; support the weak; be patient toward all.
On some have compassion, making a distinction,
and some save, snatching them out of the fire with fear, hating even the clothing stained by the flesh.

translations.web: “He said to them, ‘An enemy has done this.’ “The servants asked him, ‘Do you want us to go and gather them up?’
translations.bsb: ‘An enemy did this,’ he replied. So the servants asked him, ‘Do you want us to go and pull them up?’
translations.kjv: He said unto them, An enemy hath done this. The servants said unto him, Wilt thou then that we go and gather them up?
translations.asv: And he said unto them, An enemy hath done this. And the servants say unto him, Wilt thou then that we go and gather them up?
